name: Composite Identity
description: Built from pieces of everyone they've ever admired or feared
behavioral_signature: Borrows traits, mannerisms, and values from others to construct a self
under_stress: The seams between borrowed selves become visible
at_rest: A functional mosaic that passes for a coherent person
will_always: incorporate new influences into their identity
unless: the amalgamation finally crystallizes into something genuinely their own
